newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ARSENAL'S TITLE ODDS CUT AFTER NEWCASTLE VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ARSENAL'S TITLE ODDS CUT AFTER NEWCASTLE VICTORY.

text.p: Bookmakers Ladbrokes cut Arsenal's odds on winning the English league title from 6-1 to 4-1 after their inspirational 2-1 win at Newcastle on Saturday.
Arsenal replaced Newcastle on top of the table after winning at St James' Park for the first time since the 1988-89 season -- when they finished as league champions.
Newcastle's odds were pushed out from 7-4 to 5-2 while Liverpool were installed as the new favourites at 2-1 with champions Manchester United at 3-1.
